# Registrai

> Registrai is a data company for the Arc blockchain (by Circle). Data on the Arc ecosystem: apps on Arc with their hourly stablecoin payments, paying wallets and volume, the Arc Builders, Integrations and Ecosystem indices, and verified builders. The data lives on builder.registrai.cc.

## Data
- [Apps on Arc](https://builder.registrai.cc/apps/): every app with its last 24 h
- [Arc indices](https://builder.registrai.cc/builders-index/): ABI, AII, AEI, hourly
- [Data API v1](https://builder.registrai.cc/data-api/): public JSON API, no key, CC BY 4.0
- [Full agent guide](https://builder.registrai.cc/llms.txt): API, OpenAPI and MCP server
